paper.title: Non-Stationary Restless Multi-Armed Bandits with Provable Guarantee

settings.name_in_paper: Non-Stationary Restless Bandits (N-armed RMAB with variation budget B on transitions)
settings.out_of_scope_reason: Restless Markov arms (each arm a non-stationary discounted MDP); markovian environments are out of scope from ontology v0.5.
unmapped: Each arm is a discounted MDP with non-stationary transitions P_{t,i}; total variation budget B = sum_t sum_i max_{s,a} ||P_{t+1,i}-P_{t,i}||_1
Activation budget: at most K of N arms activated per round (in expectation via Lagrangian relaxation)
Rewards R_i(s,a) in [0,1], stationary and known to the learner; states of all arms observed every step
Regret defined via Lagrangian-relaxed discounted value functions with per-step optimal dual variable lambda*_t
settings.definition_quote: We consider an RMAB problem with $N$ restless arms over a time horizon of $T$ time steps. At each time step $t \in [T]$, the learner selects at most $K$ arms to activate... Each arm $i \in [N]$ is associated with a non-stationary discounted MDP ... The total allowable variation across all arms and time steps is then given by $B := \sum_{t=1}^T \sum_{i=1}^N B_{t,i}$.

bound.expression: 2*N_arms*V_T*W_win*(N_arms + U_lambda*K_act)/(eta_conf*(1 - gamma_d)) + 2*N_arms*(1 + U_lambda)*gamma_d/(1 - gamma_d)**2*sqrt(T*log(1/delta_p)) + gamma_d*N_arms*(U_lambda + 1)/(p_min*(1 - gamma_d)**2)*sqrt(T*log(1/delta_p)) + gamma_d*N_arms*(U_lambda + 1)/(p_min*(1 - gamma_d)**2)*(T*N_arms*eta_conf + N_arms*sqrt(2*S_size*log(S_size*A_size*T/delta))*T/sqrt(W_win)*(sqrt(2) + 1)*sqrt(S_size*A_size))

symbols.K_act: activation budget K (max arms activated per step)
symbols.W_win: sliding window size W (min over arms)
symbols.U_lambda: upper bound on optimal Lagrange multipliers lambda*_t

conditions: Assumption 5.4: lambda*_t <= U_lambda for all t
Assumption 5.6: nonzero transition probabilities bounded below by p_min
rewards R_i(s,a) in [0,1], known to learner
holds with probability at least 1 - 6 delta' - N/delta
tuning: window W_i, exploration parameter eta_i free inputs

source.label: theorem:regret bound
source.quote: With probability at least $1-6\delta' - N/\delta$, we have \text{Reg}_{\blambda^*_t}(T) = \frac{2NBW(N + U_{\lambda}K)}{\eta(1-\gamma)} + \frac{2N(1+U_\lambda)\gamma}{(1-\gamma)^2}\sqrt{T\log{\frac{1}{\delta'}}} + ...

results.notes: Regret is a relaxed Lagrangian value-based regret sum_t (V^{pi*_t}_{P_t,lambda*_t}(s_t) - V^{pi_t}_{P_t,lambda*_t}(s_t)), so quantity 'other'. The paper writes '=' but it is an upper bound. Probability statement 1 - 6delta' - N/delta is as printed (likely a typo for N*delta).

conditions: Assumption 5.6: minimum nonzero transition probability p_min

source.quote: To optimize the regret bound, we can choose $W_i^* = |S| T^{1/2} (\sum_{t=1}^TB_{t,i})^{-\frac{1}{2}}, \eta_i^*=\sqrt{BW_i^*/T}$ for arm $i$. The regret reduces to $\text{Reg}_{\blambda^*_t}(T) = \widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(N^2 |\mathcal{S}|^{\frac{1}{2}} B^{\frac{1}{4}} \delta^{-\frac{1}{2}} T^{\frac{3}{4}})$.

results.notes: Tuning requires knowledge of per-arm variation budgets and T. Introduction states B^{3/4} instead of B^{1/4}; recorded as in Remark 5.2/abstract. Derivation from Theorem 5.1 not shown.

source.quote: When the environment is stationary, i.e., $B=0$, we can choose $W = T, \eta = 1/T$ and the regret bound reduces to $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(N^2 |S| T^{\frac{1}{2}})$, which matches the best known non-episodic and episodic regret in stationary restless bandits

results.notes: Special case of Theorem 5.1 with B=0; stated in a remark.
